question: The older dialogs, Instagram and Flickr: size, tabs, rows, how each closes, and what is bound to an account.

tock.kind: a plain panel, not a dialog

closes: All nine read: no button in the dialog outside its body, no Cancel, no X. Escape leaves it open. A press on its own block leaves it open. Left by a reload. Exit in the top bar took over 5 s in an earlier read. Not tried: a press on an empty part of the page.

Instagram.why: the menu connects an outside account. Without one, the Items slider changes nothing. Aspect Ratio, Crop Images and Open Links in New Window do change the block.

Flickr.why: the same as Instagram. Aspect Ratio, Crop Images, Show Title and Open Links in New Window change the block.

Bandsintown.why: the name looks up an outside service. Timeframe reads Upcoming or Date Range and was not pressed: the walk stops at a field that can reach outside.

SoundCloud.why: its only row is an outside URL. Not typed in.

Tock.why: a sign-up for an outside service. Not pressed.

siteContentBound.Calendar: its only row says there are no collections
siteContentBound.Page Link: help and Learn more only with no page to pick
siteContentBound.Tag Cloud: says there are no collections, yet Display Type, Sort By and the Tags slider change the block

notRead: Instagram and Flickr layout pictures (Slideshow, Carousel, Grid, Stacked): the reader takes them as headings, not controls, so nothing pressed them
Chart Type options beyond a press to Line Chart: Pie Chart named, not pressed
a dialog when a collection or account exists
answer: Nine dialogs, 300 to 572 wide. Chart has three tabs, Instagram and Flickr two, the others none. None has a way out inside it.
pressed: Add Block, Edit, each dialog tab, the rows in each CAP-ROWS file, Escape, and a press on the block by its id. Nothing typed in a field that can reach outside. On a probe page, unsaved. Left by a reload.
